title: Medical Hardship Liability Cap — Plan-Burden Points from an Active Payment Plan
content:
## Plan-burden points

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), plan-burden points are taken off a Medical Hardship award's hardship liability cap percent for the installment the household already pays on the patient's active Riverbend payment plan (Patient Payment Plan), measured as a percent of one twelfth of the annual household income recorded on the case. Points are taken off the hardship liability cap percent — the percent of the annual household income recorded on the case at which the cap is figured — before the income is scaled at that percent, and the cap percent never goes below zero.

- Installment above 5.0 percent of one twelfth of the income: 2.0 points.
- Installment above 2.0 percent and at most 5.0 percent: 1.0 point.
- Otherwise, including when the patient has no active plan or no income is recorded: none.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical annual income 60,000.00, one twelfth 5,000.00)

| Monthly installment of the active plan | Percent of one twelfth | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 250.00 | 5.0 | 1.0 |
| 250.50 | 5.01 | 2.0 |
| 100.00 | 2.0 | none |
| 100.50 | 2.01 | 1.0 |
